title: I Took the Tram-Day-Pass Receipt to the Inspector Who Punched It Used

parts.text: I held the day-pass receipt at 9:11 a.m. and the inspector punched it used on a first tap. The pass said VALID ALL DAY. I was thirty-one, commuter, standing in a car that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the punch, the timestamp, and the validator still. Then I asked for the inspector log. Transit reprinted the pass and dated the punch as a first tap. I keep the still. The car finally knows a first tap from used.

social.video_title: The inspector punched my all-day tram pass used on first tap — Part 1/1
